## Goal

Abandon an active generation that cannot converge and report one explicit state with the reason and remedies, instead of re-staging and force-evicting forever; never restart the same scope automatically.

## Deliverables

- Convergence stop with an explicit user-visible reason
- Captured-store evidence

## Acceptance Criteria

- `AC-TASK-614-01` — An active generation whose processed entries exceed 20 times its staged files, whose publication is refused on consecutive slices, or whose active work exceeds 6 hours is abandoned with one explicit state naming the reason (scope too large for the store limit) and the remedies; the same scope is not restarted for 24 hours or until the scope or limit changes; the probe returns to idle.
- `AC-TASK-614-02` — A captured copy of the stuck live store (488 M processed, 123,280 staged) is stopped on first open, and the stop leaves retained evidence readable.

- `EVREQ-TASK-614-02` (regression-evidence) — Captured-store run showing the stop state and idle probe.
